data.name: Extension_Npm_Description
data.value: Installs npm packages for use in JavaScript cells.
data.comment: What the #!npm extension is, shown wherever extensions are listed.

data.name: Kernel_JavaScript_Description
data.value: JavaScript language kernel via Node.js or Jint.
data.comment: What the JavaScript kernel is, shown wherever kernels are listed.

data.name: Kernel_TypeScript_Description
data.value: TypeScript language kernel via Node.js with automatic transpilation.
data.comment: What the TypeScript kernel is, shown wherever kernels are listed.

data.name: Magic_Npm_AlreadyInstalled_One
data.comment: Nothing was done. {0} is one package name, with its version after it when that is known.

data.name: Magic_Npm_AlreadyInstalled_Other
data.comment: The same for more than one. {0} is a comma-separated list.

data.name: Magic_Npm_Description
data.value: Installs npm packages for use in subsequent JavaScript cells.
data.comment: What #!npm does, shown in the list of magic commands.

data.name: Magic_Npm_Installing
data.comment: Printed before the install starts, so a slow one does not look like nothing happening. {0} is a comma-separated list of package names.

data.name: Magic_Npm_Name
data.comment: Name of the #!npm magic command as an extension, as listed in the Extensions panel. The command word itself is typed into a cell and is not translated.

data.name: Magic_Npm_NoKernel
data.value: No JavaScript kernel is loaded. #!npm requires the JavaScript kernel.
data.comment: #!npm installs for the JavaScript kernel, and there is not one to install for.

data.name: Magic_Npm_Param_Packages
data.value: One or more package names (e.g. lodash axios@1.6).
data.comment: What the argument to #!npm is. The two package names are examples and stay as written.

data.name: Magic_Npm_Usage
data.comment: Shown when #!npm is given nothing to install. Everything after 'Usage:' is typed at a keyboard and stays as written.

data.name: Node_NotReady
data.value: Node.js bridge did not send ready signal within 10 seconds.
data.comment: Node.js started but never answered, so the cell cannot run.

data.name: Node_NotRunning
data.comment: A cell was run after the process behind it had stopped.

data.name: Node_Required
data.value: TypeScript kernel requires Node.js. Node.js was not found on PATH or in well-known locations.
data.comment: TypeScript cells cannot run without Node.js installed. PATH is the name of an environment variable and stays as written.

data.name: Node_Terminated
data.comment: The process running the cell stopped part-way through.

data.name: Node_TranspileRequiresModule
data.value: TypeScript transpilation requires Node.js with the typescript module installed.
data.comment: The built-in engine cannot compile TypeScript. 'typescript' is a package name and stays as written.

data.name: Npm_AuditSummary
data.value: npm audit found {0} in the installed packages. Run npm audit for details.
data.comment: {0} is a count already written out. 'npm audit' is a command typed at a keyboard and stays as written.

data.name: Npm_AuditSummaryBySeverity
data.value: npm audit found {0} ({1}) in the installed packages. Run npm audit for details.
data.comment: {0} is a count already written out, {1} a comma-separated breakdown such as '2 high, 1 low'.

data.name: Npm_Dependencies
data.comment: Names what came along with the request. {0} is a comma-separated list with versions.

data.name: Npm_DependencyCount_One
data.comment: How many packages came along with what was asked for, written for exactly one. Goes into the sentence above.

data.name: Npm_DependencyCount_Other
data.comment: The same for any other number.

data.name: Npm_InstallFailed
data.comment: Shown when the install failed and npm said nothing about why.

data.name: Npm_Installed
data.comment: {0} is a list of packages with their versions, or a count already written out.

data.name: Npm_InstalledAnd
data.comment: {0} is what was asked for, {1} a count of what came along with it, already written out.

data.name: Npm_NotFound
data.comment: npm is not installed, or not where it can be found. PATH is the name of an environment variable and stays as written.

data.name: Npm_NothingToDo
data.comment: The install ran and added nothing, because it was all there.

data.name: Npm_PackageCount_One
data.comment: How many packages were installed, written for exactly one.

data.name: Npm_PackageCount_Other
data.comment: The same for any other number.

data.name: Npm_Packages
data.comment: Names what was installed when none of it matches what was asked for by name. {0} is a comma-separated list with versions.

data.name: Npm_Replaced
data.comment: Names what the install took out. {0} is a comma-separated list with versions.

data.name: Npm_Severity_Critical
data.comment: How many of npm's audit findings were rated critical. {0} is the count. Goes into the breakdown in the sentence above.

data.name: Npm_Severity_High
data.comment: How many of npm's audit findings were rated high. {0} is the count. Goes into the breakdown in the sentence above.

data.name: Npm_Severity_Info
data.comment: How many of npm's audit findings were rated info. {0} is the count. Goes into the breakdown in the sentence above.

data.name: Npm_Severity_Low
data.comment: How many of npm's audit findings were rated low. {0} is the count. Goes into the breakdown in the sentence above.

data.name: Npm_Severity_Moderate
data.comment: How many of npm's audit findings were rated moderate. {0} is the count. Goes into the breakdown in the sentence above.

data.name: Npm_StartFailed
data.comment: npm was found but would not run.

data.name: Npm_VulnerabilityCount_One
data.comment: How many problems npm's audit found, written for exactly one. Goes into the sentence below.

data.name: Npm_VulnerabilityCount_Other
data.comment: The same for any other number.

data.name: Run_NodeCrashed
data.comment: The process running the cell stopped on its own and is being started again.

data.name: Run_OutOfMemory
data.comment: A cell asked the built-in engine for more memory than it is allowed.

data.name: Run_TimedOut
data.comment: A cell ran on the built-in engine for longer than it is allowed to.

data.name: Run_TranspileFailed
data.comment: TypeScript could not be turned into JavaScript. {0} is the underlying error, which arrives in English.

data.name: Run_UnknownError
data.comment: Shown in place of an error message when the engine reported a failure without saying what it was.

data.name: Run_UnknownTranspileError
data.comment: Shown in place of an error message when TypeScript would not compile and said nothing about why.

data.name: Setting_HideInstallOutput_Description
data.value: Report an npm install as the packages it added and the versions they came in at, rather than relaying npm's own narration and its funding and audit footers. Installing one package brings in its dependencies, and that block is saved into the notebook alongside the output the cell was actually run for. An install that fails is always reported in full, as is anything npm's audit found.
data.comment: What the setting above does, shown under its name in the settings panel.

data.name: Setting_HideInstallOutput_Label
data.comment: Name of a setting, shown in the settings panel. Keep it short; it sits on one line beside a switch.

data.name: TypeScript_InstallFailed
data.value: Failed to install the {0} npm package.
data.comment: {0} is the package and version being installed, such as typescript@5, which stays as written.

data.name: TypeScript_VerifyFailed
data.value: TypeScript compiler not working after install (typescript {0}): {1}
data.comment: The compiler installed but will not compile anything. {0} is the version that installed, {1} the underlying error, which arrives in English.

data.name: TypeScript_VersionUnknown
data.comment: Stands in for the version number in the message above when it could not be read.
